verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy's API docs say webhooks can be set up, with event subscriptions, programmatically through the API. The homepage also advertises webhooks for asynchronous events, so this is a registrable outbound HTTP callback that a program can receive. Missing for 10: documented event catalog, payload signing/verification and retry/delivery details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Using the API, you can set up webhooks and subscribe to events programatically.
